No battery, no brand plate, no model label, and no rear specification sticker are visible in the photo.
The seller's text describes a battery, but the photo shows only a solar panel.

claims.evidence: No battery appears in photo 0; only a solar panel is shown.
No battery or charge test is shown in photo 0.
Photo 0 cannot reveal repair history of the panel or any battery.

risks.risk: The photo shows a solar panel while the seller describes a battery; the item for sale may not match the image.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery, ideally shown together with the panel.
risks.if_unproven: Price only the visible solar panel, as non-working.

risks.risk: Panel wattage, brand, output, and electrical condition cannot be confirmed from a single front view.
risks.proof: Close-up of the rear label/sticker and a video of the panel producing power under load or sunlight.
risks.if_unproven: As a non-working solar panel of unknown capacity.

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, delamination, or frame damage may not be visible in the full shot.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the corners, edges, and cell surface.

proof_requests: Close-up of the panel's rear label showing wattage, brand, and model.
Photo of the battery the seller describes, ideally next to the panel.
Video of the panel producing power or the battery holding a charge.
response.reason: The item is visibly a solar panel and can be priced at its worst case as non-working; the seller's battery claims are not shown in the photo and cannot be verified remotely.
